questions.text: What is the main goal of Entri as a learning platform?
options: Job oriented learning and skill development
questions.explanation: Entri is a learning app that caters to job aspirants, offering preparation content to help users secure Government or Private Jobs.

questions.text: In which State was Entri started?
questions.explanation: Entri was established in Kerala with Malayalam as its primary language before expanding to other languages and regions.

questions.text: How does Entri ensure personalized learning?
options: By providing content only in English
Through automatic adaptation to each learner's skill level, time availability and language preference
By focusing only on government jobs
questions.explanation: Entri ensures personalized learning by automatically adapting its courses to match each learner's skill level, time availability, and language preference.

questions.text: When was the Entri App established?
questions.explanation: Entri was founded in 2017, marking the beginning of its journey as a learning app focused on providing vernacular content to job aspirants in India.

questions.text: In which states does Entri have offices?
questions.explanation: Entri's main headquarters is in Kakkanad, Kerala, where the company began its operations and continues coordinating its core activities, later expanded to other regions.

questions.text: What does Entri prioritize in its mission to help users secure jobs?
questions.explanation: Entri focuses on skill development and training to help users secure jobs and improve their quality of life.

questions.text: What is Entri's vision for the future?
options: To provide learning materials in multiple languages without focusing on job outcome
To become the largest job oriented vernacular learning app in India targeting 4 crore users by 2027
To expand globally and reach 1 crore users in various countries by 2025
To cater exclusively to government job aspirants in India
questions.explanation: Entri's vision is to become the largest job-oriented vernacular learning app in India, targeting 4 crore users by 2027.

questions.text: Who are Entripreneurs at Entri?
options: Users who subscribe to Entri's learning platform
Employees of Entri who are driven by a founder mindset and ownership
Trainers who curate exam oriented materials
Employees who have completed five years of service
questions.explanation: The term Entripreneurs refers to Entri employees who embody the values of ownership and a founder-like mindset.

questions.text: What does the term Legend represent at Entri?
options: Exceptional employees who have completed 5 years of service
Trainers who have created the most study materials for the platform
Employees who embody the founder mindset at the company
Users who have subscribed to Entri for five years
questions.explanation: Legends at Entri refers to employees who have completed five years of service and made significant contributions to the company's growth.

questions.text: Which team is responsible for creating and maintaining the product features that users interact with?
questions.explanation: The Engineering, Product, and Design team is responsible for developing all aspects of Entri's products, including the features that users interact with. Their main focus is to ensure that the product delivers a high-quality user experience.

questions.text: What is the main responsibility of the Academics and Content team?
options: Designing and creating course syllabus and content
questions.explanation: The Academics and Content team is responsible for developing the educational materials, including well-structured syllabuses and content, to ensure that learners have a high-quality learning experience.

questions.text: Which team ensures that users have a positive experience and are valued?
questions.explanation: The User Happiness team is dedicated to making sure that users feel satisfied and valued by addressing their concerns promptly and ensuring a positive interaction throughout their journey with Entri.

questions.text: The Media team is responsible for:
options: Creating educational content and managing placements
Producing in-app videos and managing content on platforms like YouTube
questions.explanation: The Media team focuses on creating and managing engaging content, including in-app videos and social media materials, such as content for YouTube. Their role is to create promotional and educational content across all platforms.

questions.text: Which team works closely with industry partners to assist learners with job placements?
questions.explanation: The Placements team is responsible for helping learners transition from education to employment by offering job placement assistance, resume building, and interview preparation, while also working closely with industry partners.

questions.text: What is the focus of Entri's Growth team?
options: Managing human resources and employee benefits
Driving user acquisition and retention through data and marketing
Ensuring customer happiness and resolving user issues
questions.explanation: The Growth team focuses on expanding Entri's user base by using data-driven strategies, marketing campaigns, and partnerships to attract new users and retain current ones, which is essential for the company's overall business goals.

questions.text: What is the largest team at Entri that focuses on reaching out to potential clients and driving revenue?
questions.explanation: Inside Sales is the largest team at Entri, responsible for driving revenue by reaching out to potential clients, qualifying leads, and supporting the company's overall growth. They focus on user acquisition and delivering excellent service.

questions.text: Which function ensures that Entri complies with labor laws and manages employee benefits?
questions.explanation: The Human Resources (HR) team ensures compliance with labor laws and manages employee relations, benefits, recruitment, and training. They play a vital role in maintaining a positive work environment.

questions.text: What does POSH stand for?
questions.explanation: POSH stands for Prevention of Sexual Harassment. The goal of POSH is to ensure a safe and respectful environment for all employees, protecting them from unwanted and inappropriate behavior.

questions.text: Who can be a victim of sexual harassment?
options: Any employee, regardless of their gender or employment status
questions.explanation: Anyone in the workplace, regardless of their gender or employment status, can be a victim of sexual harassment. This includes full-time, part-time, temporary, and contract workers.

questions.text: Is your complaint kept confidential in the POSH process?
options: No, your complaint details will be shared with everyone in the company.
Yes, but only if the complaint is deemed serious.
Yes, confidentiality is a key principle of the POSH process, and your complaint details will be kept confidential to protect your privacy.
No, the details are publicly disclosed once the investigation starts.
questions.explanation: In the POSH process, confidentiality is a key principle to protect the privacy of those involved. This means that when you file a complaint, the details are kept confidential and shared only with those directly involved in the investigation.

questions.text: If an employee experiences sexual harassment, whom should they approach within the POSH process?
options: The Human Resources department or Internal Committee
The senior involved in the violence
questions.explanation: If an employee experiences sexual harassment, they should approach the Human Resources department or the Internal Committee. These are the designated bodies within the POSH framework responsible for handling such complaints, conducting investigations, and ensuring appropriate actions are taken.

questions.text: What constitutes a sexual harassment?
questions.explanation: All of the above. Sexual harassment includes any unwelcome behavior of a sexual nature that creates a hostile or intimidating work environment.

questions.text: What should I do if I experience or witness sexual harassment?
options: Ignore the incident and hope it stops
Report the incident immediately to the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) or your HR department
Document the details of the incident, including dates, times, and any witnesses
questions.explanation: Both B and C. If you experience or witness sexual harassment, immediately report the incident to HR or the Internal Complaints Committee to ensure a formal investigation and accountability. Simultaneously, document all details--including dates, times, and witnesses--to provide an essential evidentiary record that supports your case.

questions.text: What is the role of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)?
options: Taking appropriate actions based on the findings
questions.explanation: All of the above. The ICC maintains a safe workplace by investigating harassment complaints thoroughly while ensuring strict confidentiality to protect all parties. They are also responsible for implementing disciplinary actions against perpetrators to ensure professional accountability and a respectful environment.

questions.text: How is a complaint investigated?
options: Conduct a thorough investigation, which may include interviews with the complainant, the accused, and any witnesses
Provide both parties with an opportunity to present their case
questions.explanation: All of the above. The ICC ensures a fair investigation by interviewing all parties, reviewing physical evidence, and allowing both the complainant and accused to present their cases. This multifaceted approach culminates in a comprehensive report with findings and recommendations.

questions.text: What actions can be taken if someone is found guilty of sexual harassment?
questions.explanation: All of the above. When an individual is found guilty of sexual harassment, the company must take decisive action to ensure workplace safety. Depending on the severity, responses range from formal warnings and role transfers to suspension or termination. In cases involving legal violations, the company may also pursue litigation to ensure full accountability and maintain a respectful environment.

slides.title: Title Slide
slides.narration: Welcome to Functions at Entri. Let's learn about how our teams work together.

slides.title: Overview of Functions
slides.narration: At a high level, Entri operates through eleven distinct functions. Think of these as the gears that keep our engine running. We're going to break them down one by one so you can understand what each team does and how they contribute to our overall success. Whether it's Engineering, Product, or User Happiness, every single function plays a vital role here.

slides.title: Engineering Team
slides.narration: First up, we have the Engineering Team. You can think of them as the backbone of our product development. They build and maintain all the technical aspects of our platform, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance. From the front-end interfaces you see to the back-end systems running silently in the background, this team ensures everything functions seamlessly. Our product's success relies heavily on their technical expertise and problem-solving skills.

slides.title: Product Team
slides.narration: Next is the Product Team. They are the ones responsible for defining our vision, strategy, and roadmap. Their goal is to ensure our product meets market demands while aligning with both user needs and our business goals. They prioritize which features get developed and when, ensuring that everything we build delivers real value to our users.

slides.title: Design Team
slides.narration: Then we have the Design Team. They focus on creating user-centered, aesthetically pleasing, and functional designs. They are the driving force behind ensuring every interaction a user has with our app is intuitive and enjoyable. By balancing functionality with creativity, they don't just deliver features, they deliver seamless and delightful experiences.

slides.title: Academics & Content Team
slides.narration: As an ed-tech company, content is king. Our Academics and Content Team is responsible for ensuring our courses feature the best syllabus and high-quality content. This talented group of academics, teachers, and creators ensures our courses are well-structured and engaging, providing an exceptional educational experience for our learners.

slides.title: User Happiness Team
slides.narration: User happiness is one of our core organizational values, and we have a dedicated team to uphold it. The User Happiness Team ensures every user receives prompt attention and priority. They work diligently to cultivate a loyal user base, making sure that every interaction leaves our users feeling satisfied and valued.

slides.title: Media Team
slides.narration: Our Media Team plays a crucial role in creating engaging content across all platforms. They produce everything from in-app video content to promotional marketing videos. They also manage our presence on YouTube and social media, ensuring our content resonates with the audience and effectively communicates our mission.

slides.title: Placements Team
slides.narration: Since our goal is helping users get job-ready, our Placements Team is essential. They bridge the gap between education and employment by providing placement assistance and working with industry partners to create job opportunities. They also guide learners on resume building and interview prep, empowering them to achieve their career goals.

slides.title: Growth Team
slides.narration: The Growth Team focuses on attracting new users and expanding our market presence. Using data analysis and marketing campaigns, they drive user acquisition and retention. By understanding user behavior, they identify opportunities to enhance our reach, ensuring more learners can benefit from our courses.

slides.title: Inside Sales Team
slides.narration: Our Inside Sales Team is actually the largest team at Entri. They are dedicated to driving revenue by reaching out to potential clients and providing exceptional service throughout the sales process. Their commitment is essential for connecting with more users and helping them achieve their educational aspirations.

slides.title: Founder's Office
slides.narration: The Founder's Office plays a critical role in strategic planning and executive decision-making. They support the CEO in driving the company's vision and mission, ensuring all initiatives align with our long-term goals. This team facilitates communication between leadership and other departments to maintain focus on key priorities.

slides.title: Human Resources
slides.narration: The HR function is vital for managing our most important asset, you, the employees. They handle recruitment, onboarding, and training to ensure a positive work environment. By focusing on employee development and engagement, HR helps align your individual goals with the company's objectives.

slides.title: Finance & Accounting
slides.narration: The Finance and Accounting team is crucial for keeping Entri financially healthy. They manage budgeting, compliance, payroll, and expenses. By ensuring accurate financial records, they help us make informed decisions and identify cost-saving opportunities, supporting our overall growth and efficiency.

slides.title: Administration & Operations
slides.narration: And finally, our Administration and Operations Team. They are key to keeping everything running smoothly by managing assets and handling daily administrative tasks. They streamline processes to allow other teams to focus on their main goals, helping us succeed as a whole.

slides.title: Core Team Members
slides.narration: Before we wrap up, I want to introduce you to some of the core team members you might see around. We have our Co-Founder and CEO, Mohammed Hisamuddin, and Co-Founder and CTO, Rahul Ramesh. We also have leaders across all functions, including Hrishikesh Bhaskaran, VP of Engineering, Ratheesh Sebastian, Head of Finance and Operations, and many others leading our Growth, Academics, and User Happiness teams.

slides.title: Functional Leadership
slides.narration: Moving on, I'd like to introduce you to the key leaders driving our major functions. On this slide, you see the individuals heading up critical departments such as Engineering, Finance, Growth, and Academics. These leaders, including our VPs and Heads of Operations, work closely with the founders to execute our strategy and ensure that every department, from Content Operations to User Happiness, is aligned with our mission.

slides.title: Extended Leadership & Operational Heads
slides.narration: Here we have more of our integral team leaders who manage specific verticals and operational areas. This group includes our Heads of HR, Media, and Product Design, as well as leaders managing specific regions and categories like Study Abroad and Corporate Relations. Their specialized expertise ensures that every aspect of our business runs smoothly and that we continue to innovate and expand our reach effectively.

slides.title: Title Slide
slides.narration: Welcome back! ... Now that we've covered the functions and teams, ... let's move on to Module 5: HR Policies. ... However, we understand that different teams have different needs, ... so there may be flexibility depending on your specific role or shift. ... slides.title: Leave Policy - Part 1
slides.narration: We believe in a healthy work-life balance. ... For Earned Leave, ... you are granted 18 days annually, ... credited at a rate of 1.5 days per month. ... If you don't use them all, don't worry, ... you can carry forward up to 30 days into the next year. ... We also provide 6 sick days at the beginning of each year ... for any health-related absences. ... Additionally, ... if you are required to work on a public holiday or weekend, ... you are eligible for Comp Off, or compensatory leave, ... to use later.

slides.narration: Everyone needs a break to recharge. ... At Entri, ... employees are entitled to 15 holidays each year, ... covering mandatory, regional, and festival occasions. ...
